title: Z-Function
intro: Functions carve a problem into named units. Pass-by-value vs reference decides whether the callee can mutate the caller’s data — interviewers love this distinction.
intuition: Name inputs/outputs. If the callee must edit caller memory, pass a reference/pointer (or return a new value).
approach: Extract a pure helper for the core calculation.
Return results instead of printing inside helpers when possible.
pitfalls: Assuming pass-by-reference when it is pass-by-value.
